🚨 CVE-2026-53985 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 7.5
Resumo:
Ground Station prior to 0.6.0 contains an unauthenticated denial-of-service vulnerability in the Socket.IO server's service_control event handler that allows any unauthenticated network peer to forcibly terminate the ground-station process by sending a single restart_service command. Attackers can connect to the Socket.IO server on port 7000 without credentials due to disabled authentication enforcement and a wildcar...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-53985

🚨 Progress Kemp LoadMaster Flaw Hits CISA KEV After 792 Reported Exploit Attempts
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 9.6
Resumo:
Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added a critical-severity security flaw impacting Progress Kemp LoadMaster to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports of active exploitation in the wild. Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/progress-kemp-loadmaster-flaw-hits-cisa.html
 
🚨 CVE-2026-43629 - Check Point
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.1
Resumo:
llama.cpp builds b4882 through b9058 contain a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the KV cache state restore path where the state_read_data() function computes write size without overflow checking, allowing attackers with write access to the slot_save_path directory to corrupt heap memory. Attackers can craft malicious state files where cell_count multiplication overflows or exceeds tensor buffer allocation to wri...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-43629
 
💣 Metabase SQLi zero-day exploited in customer data-theft attacks
 
Criticidade: Alta

Fonte: BleepingComputer

A publicação menciona exploração ativa, técnica ofensiva ou abuso envolvendo SentinelOne. Consulte o link para entender melhor o impacto e as recomendações.

💣 N-able Issues N-central Hotfix 2 as Attackers Reach Managed Systems and Persist
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
N-able has released a fresh round of hotfixes for N‑central as part of its investigation into ongoing exploitation of a recently disclosed security flaw in the Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) product. "We are proactively expanding protections in response to ongoing monitoring of threat actors as they evolve their attack techniques," the company said.
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/n-central-attackers-reach-managed.html
 
💣 Hackers breach TrueConf to trojanize client installers with backdoors
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
The Head Mare hacktivist group has been exploiting vulnerabilities in unpatched TrueConf video conferencing servers to replace client installers with malicious versions that deliver backdoors.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/hackers-breach-trueconf-to-trojanize-client-installers-with-backdoors/

Sistemas / Cloud - 1Password / Azure / Office / Ubuntu / Windows Server / WordPress

🚨 CVE-2026-3430 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.6
Resumo:
The Creative Mail WordPress plugin from 1.6.5 to 1.6.9 does not sanitize and escape a parameter before using in an SQL statement, leading to an unauthenticated SQL injection when the abandoned cart email is managed by creative mail.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-3430
 
🚨 CVE-2025-15674 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 2.7
Resumo:
The Passster WordPress plugin before 4.3.7 does not restrict low-privilege users holding the edit_posts capability from reading globally password-protected content through the WordPress core REST API when global protection is enabled, allowing any Contributor or higher to read the content of protected pages and posts without knowing the password.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-15674
